strings.chinese: 你为什么要在乎别人的命？又麻木又无聊！除非他们对你有什么价值……

strings.english: Spiritual
strings.lookup_english: Spiritual
strings.spanish: Espiritual
strings.chinese: 灵修者

strings.english: Crystals, horoscopes and you probably believe tarot cards mean something, you are not religious but you dare think you can achieve some kind of nirvana
strings.lookup_english: Crystals, horoscopes and you probably believe tarot cards mean something, you are not religious but you dare think you can achieve some kind of nirvana
strings.spanish: Los cristales, el horóscopo... probablemente creas en las cartas el tarot. No eres religioso pero te atreves a creer que así puedes alcanzar algún tipo de nirvana.
strings.chinese: 水晶、星座，你大概还相信塔罗牌有什么意义。你不信教，却胆敢妄想达到某种涅槃

strings.english: Star
strings.lookup_english: Star
strings.spanish: Estrella
strings.chinese: 明星

strings.english: You were famous before the rapture! maybe a singer, or actor or any other type of famous person, you may find one of your fans in the colony!
strings.lookup_english: You were famous before the rapture! maybe a singer, or actor or any other type of famous person, you may find one of your fans in the colony!
strings.spanish: ¡Eras famoso antes del rapto! Tal vez un cantante, actor o cualquier otro tipo de celebridad, ¡puede que te encuentres a uno de tus fans en la colonia!
strings.chinese: 你在被提之前很有名！也许是歌手、演员或其他什么名人，你可能会在居住处里遇到你的一个粉丝！

strings.english: Strong Will
strings.lookup_english: Strong Will
strings.spanish: Voluntad fuerte
strings.chinese: 坚强意志

strings.english: No danger can break your will, not even the imminent extinction of mankind or the demons walking the earth, you will survive no matter what
strings.lookup_english: No danger can break your will, not even the imminent extinction of mankind or the demons walking the earth, you will survive no matter what
strings.spanish: Ningún peligro puede doblegar tu voluntad, ni siquiera la inminente extinción de la humanidad o los demonios que caminan por la tierra, sobrevivirás pase lo que pase.
strings.chinese: 任何危险都无法摧毁你的意志，哪怕是人类即将灭绝，或恶魔行走于世，你无论如何都会活下去

strings.english: Stunning
strings.lookup_english: Stunning
strings.spanish: Impresionante
strings.chinese: 万人迷

strings.english: Your appearance is your top priority, you don't get out of home without checking yourself in the mirror at least 50 times, everyone notices you and you love that
strings.lookup_english: Your appearance is your top priority, you don't get out of home without checking yourself in the mirror at least 50 times, everyone notices you and you love that
strings.spanish: Tu apariencia es tu máxima prioridad, no sales de casa sin mirarte al espejo al menos 50 veces, todos se fijan en ti y eso te encanta.
strings.chinese: 你的外表是你最优先考虑的事。不照镜子至少五十次，你绝不会出门。所有人都注意到你，而你喜欢这样。

strings.english: Techie
strings.lookup_english: Techie
strings.spanish: Técnico
strings.chinese: 科技迷

strings.english: You were amazed by the technological advances of the XXI century, it's a shame tech companies don't operate in the apocalypse
strings.lookup_english: You were amazed by the technological advances of the XXI century, it's a shame tech companies don't operate in the apocalypse
strings.spanish: Te maravillaron los avances tecnológicos del siglo XXI, es una pena que las empresas tecnológicas ya no operen en el apocalipsis.
strings.chinese: 你曾惊叹于21世纪的技术进步。可惜科技公司在末日里不运营了

strings.english: Troll
strings.lookup_english: Troll
strings.spanish: Bromista
strings.chinese: 喷子

strings.english: You love to make jokes, even if they are only funny to you, making people rage at you gives you years of life, you nugget
strings.lookup_english: You love to make jokes, even if they are only funny to you, making people rage at you gives you years of life, you nugget
strings.spanish: Te encanta hacer bromas, aunque solo te hagan gracia a ti, hacer que la gente se enfade contigo te da años de vida, alcornoque.
strings.chinese: 你喜欢开玩笑，哪怕只有你自己觉得好笑。把别人惹毛能让你延年益寿，你这小坏蛋。

strings.english: Unemployed
strings.lookup_english: Unemployed
strings.spanish: Nini
strings.chinese: 无业游民

strings.english: Your mother is starting to get tired of your attitude, you wish you could care as much as she does but, naaah
strings.lookup_english: Your mother is starting to get tired of your attitude, you wish you could care as much as she does but, naaah
strings.spanish: Tu madre está empezando a cansarse de tu actitud... desearías que te importara tanto como a ella pero... naaah
strings.chinese: 你妈开始受不了你的态度了……你希望自己能像她那么在乎，可是……算了吧

strings.english: Unfaithful
strings.lookup_english: Unfaithful
strings.spanish: Infiel
strings.chinese: 不忠

strings.english: Even if it was the love of your life, another love of your life appeared, and then another, and another
strings.lookup_english: Even if it was the love of your life, another love of your life appeared, and then another, and another
strings.spanish: Aunque fuera el amor de tu vida... apareció otro amor de tu vida, y luego otro, y otro...
strings.chinese: 哪怕那是你一生的挚爱……另一个一生的挚爱又出现了，然后又一个，又一个……

strings.english: Vegetarian
strings.lookup_english: Vegetarian
strings.spanish: Vegetariano
strings.chinese: 素食主义者

strings.english: You do this for the animals! after all you can have a balanced diet without meat, right?
strings.lookup_english: You do this for the animals! after all you can have a balanced diet without meat, right?
strings.spanish: ¡Haces esto por los animales! Al fin y al cabo se puede llevar una dieta equilibrada sin carne, ¿verdad?
strings.chinese: 你这是为了动物！毕竟没有肉也能保持均衡饮食，对吧？

strings.english: War criminal
strings.lookup_english: War criminal
strings.spanish: Criminal de guerra
strings.chinese: 战犯

strings.english: You have seen and done things you wish to forget, at least you had the luck to return home, unlike your comrades
strings.lookup_english: You have seen and done things you wish to forget, at least you had the luck to return home, unlike your comrades
strings.spanish: Has visto y hecho cosas que deseas olvidar. Al menos tuviste la suerte de volver a casa, a diferencia de tus camaradas.
strings.chinese: 你见过、做过一些希望忘记的事。至少你运气好，回了家，不像你的战友们。

strings.english: Weeb
strings.lookup_english: Weeb
strings.spanish: Otaku
strings.chinese: 死宅

strings.english: You love Japanese cartoons, nothing wrong with that, but you also constantly talk to anyone about them to the point of being really fucking annoying
strings.lookup_english: You love Japanese cartoons, nothing wrong with that, but you also constantly talk to anyone about them to the point of being really fucking annoying
strings.spanish: Te encantan los dibujos animados japoneses. No tiene nada de malo, pero hablas constantemente con cualquiera sobre ello hasta dejar a todos hasta las pelotas.
strings.chinese: 你热爱日本动画，这本身没什么问题，但你还不停地跟任何人聊这些，烦得要命。

strings.english: Workaholic
strings.lookup_english: Workaholic
strings.spanish: Trabajador obsesivo
strings.chinese: 工作狂

strings.english: Work, work and more work, there's no time to waste, no time to rest, you have to work and you have to do it NOW!
strings.lookup_english: Work, work and more work, there's no time to waste, no time to rest, you have to work and you have to do it NOW!
strings.spanish: Trabajo, trabajo y más trabajo, no hay tiempo que perder, no hay tiempo para descansar, hay que trabajar y hay que hacerlo ¡YA!
strings.chinese: 工作，工作，还是工作。没时间浪费，没时间休息，你必须工作，而且必须现在就去！

strings.english: Young Adult
strings.lookup_english: Young Adult
strings.spanish: Adulto joven
strings.chinese: 青年

strings.english: 18-25, Gen Y or best called Millennials, this generation grew up in a modern and globalized world, they seem to be the worst candidates to survive the rapture
strings.lookup_english: 18-25, Gen Y or best called Millennials, this generation grew up in a modern and globalized world, they seem to be the worst candidates to survive the rapture
strings.spanish: 18-25, Generación Y o más bien Millenials, esta generación creció en un mundo moderno y globalizado, parecen ser los peores candidatos para sobrevivir al rapto.
strings.chinese: 18-25岁，Y世代，或者最好称作千禧一代。这一代人成长于现代且全球化的世界，他们似乎是最不适合在被提中幸存的人选

strings.english: Zealot
strings.lookup_english: Zealot
strings.spanish: Fanático
strings.chinese: 狂热者

strings.english: Your faith is uncontrollable, since God didn't choose you, you'll do anything to gain his trust, nothing is enough to express your faith
strings.lookup_english: Your faith is uncontrollable, since God didn't choose you, you'll do anything to gain his trust, nothing is enough to express your faith
strings.spanish: Tu fe es incontrolable, y ya que Dios no te eligió, harás cualquier cosa para ganarte su confianza, nada es suficiente para expresar tu fe.
strings.chinese: 你的信仰无法控制。既然上帝没有选择你，你会做任何事来赢得他的信任，没有什么足以表达你的信仰
